title: vigil-sre · Calibración de umbrales
description: A qué porcentaje del tiempo dispararía cada umbral candidato, medido sobre 920 sondeos reales del 3 al 17 de agosto de 2026.

panels.title: Backend: % de sondeos que superarían cada umbral
panels.description: Cada celda es la tasa de disparo si ese fuera el umbral. La columna '500 ms (hoy)' es el estado actual: en cloudflare.com dispara el 63.8% de las veces, que es por qué aparece DEGRADED dos de cada tres sondeos.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  url AS target,
  COUNT(*) AS muestras,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "500 ms (hoy)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 750 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "750 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "1000 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "1500 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "2000 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "3000 ms"
FROM probe_results
WHERE server_processing_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY url ORDER BY url

panels.title: Mediana del backend contra el umbral vigente
panels.description: Margen positivo significa que el umbral está POR DEBAJO de la mediana del target: no mide una anomalía, mide el funcionamiento normal. Un umbral así no se puede silenciar sin apagar la regla entera.

targets.queryText:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT url, server_processing_ms AS v,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY url ORDER BY server_processing_ms) AS cd
  FROM probe_results WHERE server_processing_ms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT url AS target,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END)) AS p50,
  500 AS umbral_actual,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END))
    - 500 AS margen
FROM r GROUP BY url ORDER BY margen DESC
targets.rawQueryText:

  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END))
    - 500 AS margen
FROM r GROUP BY url ORDER BY margen DESC

panels.title: Distribución del tiempo de backend
panels.description: Dónde vive cada target. Si la masa de un target está a la derecha del umbral, el umbral no le corresponde.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%s', run_started_at) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.google.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "google.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.github.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "github.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.cloudflare.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "cloudflare.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://httpbin.org/status/200' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "httpbin.org"
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
